purpose: Emphasize a quantity as surprisingly large.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
I walked for a whole hour to the station.
As many as a hundred people came to the venue.
This book costs as much as three thousand yen.
restrictions: The surprise comes from the speaker’s expectations rather than a fixed numerical threshold.
mistake: This も need not mean another item too.

segments.role: Emphasize a quantity as surprisingly large. Quantity expression + も.
